honesty: Images are real MNI152NLin2009cAsym 1 mm T2w/T1w template slices (TemplateFlow); the third strip panel is a view-only unsharp mask of T2w. Subfield labels, strokes, proposals, rater B and all counts are mock data; editing is simulated (no bridge). Direction h states a native 0.40x0.40/2.0 mm T2 geometry that is SIMULATED: the imagery stays 1 mm, native slices are every second template slice. Round 5 (direction h workflow states): the FLAIR in state lesion is a MOCK derived from the MNI152 T1w template and its lesions are synthetic; AI answers, servers, journals, files and times are mock. Round 6: every session fact (journal, provenance, ruler and matrix marks) comes from one mock session model; the lesion T1w/T2w are the real templates. Round 7: the AI state is the same session model at step 31; the setup checkerboard pairs the T1w and T2w templates (a perfect registration).

states.description: Empty session: T2w and T1w loaded, no segmentation yet
Tracing: brush mid-stroke on the oblique coronal T2w, constraint strip, label list
Multi-contrast Trace layout: primary, two orthogonal panels, linked contrast strip
Blocked stroke: painting CA1 over the locked DG; the UI explains why nothing happened
Fill-between-slices proposal: hatched CA1 with a thin solid outline, accept per slice, keyframes, proposal undo
Review mode: rater A solid, rater B dashed where it departs, disagreement textures, flagged navigation, approve/return
Zoomed tracing: 6x with voxel grid and the exact brush footprint

AI assist (nnInteractive) at the session moment after step 31: prompts on the slice, the 3D answer (k 5-13, the journal's step 32′) as a CA1 proposal reviewed slice by slice, a two-line bar, over-reach checked on the slice and the ruler
decisions: The state is session.ts as of step 31 (as the licence gate) with the first answer pending: nine slices k 5-13, k 11, 10 and 12 looked at, exactly the branch step 32′ that history keeps.
Per-slice accept is the default: 'Accept CA1 here ↵' writes k 11 and steps to the next unseen slice (k 9); 'Confirm all 9…' is a quiet secondary alone on the right.
The bar is two lines: progress (pips, '3 of 9 slices seen', 'then k 9', voxels, provider) and four actions (Accept, Discard, prompt undo as an icon with ⌥Z in its tooltip, Confirm all…).

Over-reach: one halo tag on the slice below the structure ('check 7 vx · ERC 4, empty · Subiculum 3') beside the neutral voxel outline; empty labels are checked against the prior's territory within 5 mm; answer slices outside the body slab (k 5) get their own 'check' run on the ruler. The kept count is in the key's tooltip.

Orthogonal views: CA1 as the session had it (fill), the answer past it in a coarser CA1 hatch with one outline around the whole answer; the axial view marks the proposed slab k 5-13 (faint tilted band between hairlines).
The CA1 island keeps its ring and the inline 'island' key.
states.mocked: The model's answer on this slice is the mock CA1 still to trace plus a one-voxel rim, gated by the real rule; on other slices it is the mock CA1 on the slices empty at step 31; ERC's prior territory is the template example; no server is called.

states.description: First-use licence gate, shown at the moment before AI was first used (session step 31): no AI marks anywhere; one sentence of what is recorded, the record behind 'Show record'
decisions: The ruler is the session as of step 31 (session.ts, asOf): CA1 k 8-10 and 12-14 were not traced yet and nothing is marked AI.
Local server selected and open; the remote option is one line with its warning icon (what leaves in the tooltip) until selected.
Recorded: one plain sentence; the JSON record behind 'Show record'. Lab policy can pre-acknowledge; a new licence version reopens the gate.
states.mocked: Server status, version and URL are mock; nothing is contacted.

states.description: WMH on a mock FLAIR, outline only, while L1's type is set: T1w and T2w at the primary's exact scale in the side column, seed rows with types printed only when not WMH, span and mm³ bars, Fazekas provisional
decisions: WMH is outline only by default (no inset fill); the brush preview is the only fill; 'Outline only' shows as on.

While a type is set (row open), T1w over T2w (real templates) replace the coronal/sagittal cuts, drawn at the primary's centre and px-per-mm and cropped to the tile: true small multiples. No strip below the primary and no whole-slice tile (Fit, Z, is the overview), so the FLAIR has its height back.
Rows came from an imported LST-AI seed as unreviewed rows; a row prints its type only when it is not WMH; the span axis is labelled once ('k 113 → 84'), the per-row axis rule lightened.
Each row: a span bar on the ruler's axial-k axis with the current k marked, and a mm³ bar on one scale.
Fazekas periventricular and deep per subject, 'provisional · 4 lesions to review' while rows are unreviewed; connectivity '26-connected' in the protocol line.
states.mocked: FLAIR is a mock made from the 1 mm MNI152 T1w template (non-monotonic intensity map, blur, noise); the six lesions are synthetic blobs with a partial-volume membership (tools/design/segmentation_flair_assets.py). T1w and T2w are the real templates on the same slice; the LST-AI seed is the mock mask itself.

states.description: Lesions at fit: the whole axial FLAIR slice in the primary with every lesion tag (Z toggles back to L1)
decisions: Fit (Z) and 'L1 · 3.7×' are one segmented control in the header.
Every lesion on the slice is outlined and tagged as halo text at one tag size (as at L1 zoom); reviewed lesions quiet, the current active.
The side column shows the coronal and sagittal cuts through L1 with the axial band at 0.30 and edge hairlines (visible at tile scale); the type row stays closed.
No brush and no range strip at fit; the Inspector keeps the list, seed and Fazekas.
states.mocked: Same mock FLAIR and synthetic lesions as state lesion.

states.description: Contrast aids after a quiet ⌘S: square T1w lens with a 1 px rim and halo caption, the view-only filter badge, the island key inline, 'Saved 14:33' in the header
decisions: The lens is a square window (never read as the island ring), 1 px neutral rim over a halo, its caption as halo text below the rim.
The island ring keeps its inline key on header line 2.
⌘S wrote silently to the remembered path: the session header says 'Saved 14:33', no sheet.
Flicker keys V raw, T T1w (Space stays pan); a filter on a stroke is recorded in provenance; a pack-set filter would badge 'set by pack'.
View aids is one line ('display only · never written · filters recorded') with the rest behind '?'; the filter and lens switches show on while they show.
states.mocked: The filter is the generator's view-only unsharp mask of the template T2w; T1w is the template T1w.

states.description: History dock at 8 rows (about a quarter of the primary, resizable and collapsible) with signed vx bars, the kept branch as one row with its AI status and Restore
decisions: One step count: '17 steps since the 14:02 save · 1 kept branch' in the dock header only (the session header says 'unsaved since 14:02', the status bar the journal's age, Autosave its size); the same 17 resume recovers and save reports.
The kept branch (32′ AI confirm all, 33′ eraser) is one row at its branch point: '6 not reviewed', Restore… warns that it brings them back.
Signed vx bars on one scale beside each count; label and k filters in the dock header.
Steps confirmed without a look say '· 1 not reviewed' (AI k 9) and '· 2 not reviewed' (fill between k 12-13), matching the ruler's hollow marks.
A row prints its label's name only where it changes from the row above; the swatch stays.
states.mocked: Steps, times, sizes and voxel sets are mock; per-label undo counts come from the real rule on mock voxel sets.

states.description: Save as / export…: ⌘S saves silently; the sheet's sections are one line each, dseg.tsv the only default table, a draft warning for unreviewed slices, one sentence of what is recorded
decisions: Title 'Save as / export…'; ⌘S writes the same files to the remembered path without the sheet.
Label volume, label table and provenance collapse to one summary line each; dseg.tsv is the only default table (ITK-SNAP and FreeSurfer LUT opt-in, FreeSurfer ids mapped by name).
Unreviewed slices warn and save as status draft; only Mark complete waits.
Provenance codes: manual, interpolated reviewed / not reviewed, AI reviewed / not reviewed, from the session model, summing to the labelled voxels.
BIDS: ses and a rater desc, no space entity (SpatialReference in the sidecar), the provenance volume has its own suffix.
states.mocked: Paths, hash, times and software version are mock; table previews come from the real writers on the mock label table.

states.description: Reopening after a crash: 17 recovered steps (22-38, the same journal as history), the last edit outlined with a halo-text tag
decisions: Counts come from the session model: recovered = steps since the last save.
'last edit · 14:31' is halo text beside the stroke, no chip; the island key is inline.
After the first stroke the banner collapses to one line and 'Show changes' (stepping through history hover outlines) stays until the next save.
states.mocked: The crash, the journal and the times are mock.

states.description: Session setup with the registration check in the primary: T1w in 8 mm squares over T2w at tracing zoom over the hippocampus, 'Aligned' unticked with the confirmer recorded; a 200 px slab locator; Add label collapsed
decisions: Subject/session/hemisphere/rater fields name the files; blinding hides other raters' labels until submission.
The grid choice shows the 20-slice slab tilted 30° on a 200 px sagittal T2w, k 20 and k 1 labelled outside the slab's ends.

Registration: while section 3 is open the primary is the check (checkerboard, with T1w edges and flicker as alternatives), at tracing zoom over the hippocampus, squares anchored to the image; 'Aligned at the hippocampus' starts unticked and records the confirmer, time, transform hash and view; 'Not aligned…' re-registers or traces without T1w aids; Start tracing waits for it.
'+ Add label' is collapsed; when open, only offered colours show, the refused ones behind one line.
states.mocked: The palette, the pack and the new label (Fimbria, id 7) are mock; T1w and T2w are the templates, so the checkerboard shows a perfect registration.

changes.change: T1w and T2w are drawn at the primary's px-per-mm and centre (SliceView pxPerMm), cropped to the tile: true small multiples.

While L1's type is set, T1w/T2w replace the coronal/sagittal column; the strip below the primary and the whole-slice tile are gone (Fit, Z, is the overview); the FLAIR gets its height back. At fit the cuts return and the type row is closed.

Orthogonal views: CA1 as the session had it at step 31 (fill), the answer past it in a coarser CA1 hatch (pitch 6.5 px) with one outline around the whole answer; the axial view marks the proposed slab k 5-13 (faint tilted band between hairlines, 'proposed k 5-13').
The cuts' axial band is 0.30 with edge hairlines (was 0.14, invisible at tile scale); outlines stay above it.

A lesion row prints its type only when not WMH; the span axis is labelled once ('k 113 → 84') and its per-row rule lightened; a history row prints the label name only where it changes from the row above.
The slab locator is 200 px wide with heavier k 1 / k 20 lines and their labels outside the slab's ends.
One lesion tag size at every zoom; DESIGN's 'inset fill' line now says outline only.

The bar is two lines: progress (pips, 3 of 9 seen, then k 9, voxels, provider) and four actions: Accept and Discard left, prompt undo as an icon (⌥Z in its tooltip, no prose), Confirm all 9… alone on the right. The check count is on the slice, the kept count in the key's tooltip.
The primary is the registration check at tracing zoom over the hippocampus (T1w in 8 mm squares over T2w, anchored to the image); 'Aligned' starts unticked; Start tracing waits for it.
Type printed only when not the default; the axis labelled once.
View aids is one line ('display only · never written · filters recorded') with the rest behind '?'; the lens switch shows on while the lens shows.

One step count: '17 steps since the 14:02 save · 1 kept branch' in the dock header; the session header says 'unsaved since 14:02', the status bar the journal's age; Autosave keeps only the journal's size and budget; the footer has no count.
Registration check in the primary, unticked; ticking records the confirmer, time, transform hash and view; 'Not aligned…' re-registers or traces without T1w aids.

Over-reach also checks empty labels (ERC, 0 vx) against the prior's territory within 5 mm (EMPTY_PRIOR_MARGIN_VX) and answer slices outside the body slab k 6-14 (slicesOutside: k 5, a 'check' run on the ruler); one halo tag on the slice: 'check 7 vx · ERC 4, empty · Subiculum 3'.

ai-prompt is session.ts as of step 31 (AI.asOf = BEFORE_AI): the pending answer is the journal's branch step 32′ (k 5-13, k 10-12 looked at, 6 unseen), so the ruler, matrix and bar agree with history's kept branch.
Fazekas reads 'provisional · 4 lesions to review' while rows are unreviewed (the static part of the interactive item).

conflicts.issue: Over-reach in the bar (operator: separate check items) vs a shorter bar (jobs: check count on the slice)
conflicts.decision: One halo tag on the slice with the per-label counts, out-of-range slices as a ruler 'check' run; nothing in the bar.
conflicts.why: The count sits next to the voxels it is about, and the bar keeps four actions.

conflicts.issue: Lesion typing: T1w/T2w as a strip (round 6) vs in place of the cuts (jobs)
conflicts.decision: In place of the cuts while a type is set; the cuts otherwise.
conflicts.why: Typing compares contrasts at the same voxels; the cuts serve finding and bounding, not typing.

not_done: Interactive or real-data items from round 6 (history dock use and hover, FLAIR/T1 flicker and cursor values, confluent WMH split/merge and seed provenance, toggle feel, latency): see docs/design/segmentation/critiques.md.
ai-consent: the operator noted 'Use nnInteractive' looks enabled before the box is ticked; it is disabled with the shared Button's disabled style, left to the design system.
The setup checkerboard pairs two template images, so it can only show a perfect registration; a planted offset is a prototype test.
